text:
olivia: Quick sync — I skimmed vendor roadmaps this morning. Need to align marketplace listing, Dedicated capacity commits, and joint announcement timing for H100/H200/B200, MI300 and Gaudi. Can vendors confirm GA-ish windows and what we can get for testing images/AMIs?

nvidia_reena: Reena (NVIDIA) here. H100 stable. H200: preliminary GA target Oct 12. B200 partner variants more Q4 (no hard GA yet). Driver + container images scheduled mid-Sep; we can provide perf images week of Sep 25.

amd_igor: Igor (AMD). MI300 rolling availability — cluster partners target Sep 30 for initial capacity. MI300v2 beta projected for Nov. We'll need a firmware/compat flag in the runtime; will share test AMIs.

sam: Sam (eng): Important — do we have firm kernel/driver ABI freeze dates? Our serving runtime needs to lock libcuda/librocm interfaces. @nvidia_reena @amd_igor any firm freeze windows?

nvidia_reena: Kernel ABI should be stable after Sep 15. We'll publish patch notes and compat matrix. Also will hand over container images for tuning.

maria: Maria (product): GTM needs a 2-week head's up before marketplace listing and verified perf numbers. Can vendors supply an embargoed performance sheet we can use internally?

kevin: Kevin (partnerships): Also need committed capacity numbers for Dedicated pricing talks. @amd_igor can marketing collateral be co-branded and ready for review by Oct 5?

amd_igor: Yes — we can do co-brand asset review by Oct 3. Request Redwood legal to send the asset waiver + logo rules doc.

joe: Joe (qa): Requesting access to vendor alpha hardware for perf runs ideally week of Oct 2. Also please include sample prompts/loads so we can reproduce tail-latency.

anna: Anna (sre): Region availability? H200 and MI300 initially only in certain regions — we need to pre-config routing and fallback policies in the control plane. Which regions are in scope?

nvidia_reena: Correct — H200 initially targeted for us-west2 and eu-central. We'll expand later; will share region list and expected capacity ramps.

sam: Action items I captured: 1) Vendors deliver test images/AMIs by Sep 25, 2) Redwood eng runs validation by Oct 9, 3) Marketing freeze + joint announcement window Oct 12–16, 4) Legal/marketing asset exchange by Oct 3. Any objections?

kevin: :thumbsup: Partnerships team good with that cadence.

maria: :eyes: I'll block Oct 12 for a joint announcement standup and create a calendar invite with vendors + GTM.

joe: Quick technical note — B200 perf behaves differently under int8 quantization; I'll drop a repro script in the perf repo: `scripts/repro_b200.sh` with workload + seed.

nvidia_reena: We'll try to provide microbenchmarks (latency P95/P99 and memory curves) to help tuning.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: Reminder — marketplace listing checklist is at https://redwood.internal/marketplace-checklist (see step 4 for co-branded assets).

olivia: Thanks all. I'll send a short spreadsheet with the dates + capacity asks and invite the follow-up working session. If vendors can drop the test images link and an embargoed perf sheet here that'd be ideal.
